title: What Is a Foil Character — How to Make Your Protagonist Shine
skills: define a foil character and explain its literary purpose
identify meaningful contrasts between a protagonist and a foil
analyze how character contrasts reveal traits, values, and motivations
explain how foil relationships contribute to theme and narrative development
alignment_note: Explains how foil characters are used to highlight important qualities in a protagonist through contrast. Supports characterization, comparative analysis, close reading, thematic interpretation, and narrative writing across high school English courses.
